title: Jude and the Alibi
author: Lena Joubert
blurb: Xanthe Eriksen, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
